column1: # The text every study page drew before the families migrated
# Recorded from commit a0c8900 - the atlas as 1.11.0 shipped it, with
# each family placing its own labels - by a dump of the three passes'
# own decisions: the star pass's placements, the deep-sky labels at
# their published bounds, and the constellation names on their
# anchors. It is frozen evidence and no target regenerates it: the
# code that produced it is not checked out any more.
# One line per drawn label: page, family, catalogue id, box x, y,
# width, height, and the text. Boxes are measured text, so this is a
# fact about the machine that recorded it (macOS 15.5, aarch64,
# Homebrew OpenJDK 21) as well as about the atlas.
